title: Role of Migrant Domestic Workers in Singapore's Caregiving Landscape
what_it_is: Role of Migrant Domestic Workers in Singapore's Caregiving Landscape

sections.label: Ageing Singaporeans and hospital stays
sections.summary: One in five Singaporeans will be over 65 by 2030, and in 2019 patients aged 65 and above spent an average of 6.9 days in public hospitals versus 3.9 days for younger patients.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: One in five Singaporeans will be aged over 65 years old by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: For instance, in 2019, patients aged 65 and above spent an average of 6.9 days in a public hospital, compared with 3.9 days for those who were younger.

sections.label: Dual-income households rise
sections.summary: Households with both husband and wife working increased from 47.1% in 2010 to 52.5% in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Households with both husband and wife working increased from 47.1% in 2010 to 52.5% in 2020.

sections.label: Migrant domestic workers in caregiving
sections.summary: MDWs can fetch toddlers or seniors from care centres when parents or children work overtime or irregular hours, and their number rose 27% to 255,800 from 2010 to June 2019.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: For instance, the MDW can help to fetch the toddler or senior from the care centre should the parents or children work overtime or have irregular working hours.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: That MDWs are an integral part of the caregiving landscape in Singapore can be observed by how the number of MDWs increased 27% to 255,800 from 2010 to June 2019.

sections.label: MDWs demanding contract transfers
sections.summary: Some MDWs with ongoing contracts demanded to end existing contracts so they could transfer to employers who could pay more.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Consequently, some MDWs with an ongoing contract demanded to end existing contracts so that they could be transferred to employers who could pay more.

sections.label: Abuse allegations to force transfers
sections.summary: In some instances where families were reluctant to transfer requests, allegations of abuse were made to force a transfer.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: In some instances where families were reluctant to the transfer requests, allegations of abuse were made to force a transfer.

sections.label: MOM relaxes vaccinated MDW entry
sections.summary: MOM relaxed measures to allow vaccinated migrant domestic workers to enter Singapore from 1 November 2021.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: The good news now is that the MOM has relaxed the measures to allow vaccinated migrant domestic workers to enter Singapore just a few days ago from 1 November 2021.

sections.label: MDW levy for high-income households
sections.summary: A speaker asks whether a higher MDW levy tier for high-income non-local households could ensure equitable access to MDWs for ordinary Singaporean families with care needs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: So, the first one is that it is important to ensure equitable access to hiring MDWs for ordinary Singaporean families with real care needs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Thus, could we consider introducing a higher tier of MDW levy for high-income non-local households to mitigate the imbalance of paying power?

sections.label: Singapore population ageing by 2050
sections.summary: By 2050, almost half of Singapore's total population will be at least 65.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: By 2050, almost half of Singapore's total population will be at least 65.

sections.label: MDWs as all-in-one care solution
sections.summary: Multiple application processes can seem piece-meal, many adult children rely on an MDW as an all-in-one care solution, and about a quarter of a million MDWs held work permits as of June 2021.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: However, they can come across as piece-meal with multiple application processes and many adult children rely on an MDW as an all-in-one solution to care for their aged parents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: There is almost a quarter of a million MDWs here on work permits as of June 2021.

sections.label: Medical transport round trip costs
sections.summary: Round trips for medical transport services cost between $62 and $90 before subsidies, which can be unaffordable for some.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Round trips for medical transport services are between $62 and $90 before subsidies, which can be unaffordable for some.

sections.label: Grant for permanent moderate disability
sections.summary: The grant currently provides a $200 monthly payout to families supporting loved ones with permanent moderate disability.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Currently, the grant provides a $200 monthly payout to families supporting their loved ones with permanent moderate disability.

sections.label: Combining scores and caregiver compensation
sections.summary: Combining scores can give a fuller picture of families in greater financial need, and compensating part-time family caregivers better could be explored, as in Hawaii's Kupuna Caregivers Assistance Act.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: A combination of these scores can provide a fuller picture for families in greater financial need versus separating the financial and functional criteria.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In addition, we can also explore compensating part-time family caregivers better under the grant.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In Hawaii, for example, their Kupuna Caregivers Assistance Act provides a daily stipend to a caregiver who is also working 30 hours a week.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: This approach allows caregivers to continue working in some capacity, or dial back at work while assuming caregiving responsibilities.

sections.label: Levy rates for non-local households
sections.summary: Only households with a Singaporean member with care needs get the $60 concessionary levy; all non-local households pay $300 monthly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Members have suggested higher levy for non-local high-income households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: This is why only households with at least a Singaporean member with care needs are eligible for the concessionary levy rate of $60 per month.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: All non-local households, with or without caregiving needs, pay the non-concessionary rate of $300 per month.

sections.label: Sharing SHN and COVID-19 test costs
sections.summary: MOM introduced a policy letting incumbent and subsequent employers share an MDW's SHN and COVID-19 test costs if employer change occurs within 12 months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: To alleviate the financial burden incurred by employers, MOM recently introduced a policy to allow the incumbent and subsequent employers to share the Stay-Home Notice (SHN) costs and COVID-19 tests costs incurred by an MDW when she entered Singapore, should the change of employer take place within 12 months of employment.

sections.label: Employers hiring MDWs via agencies
sections.summary: More than 80% of employers hire their MDWs with the help of an employment agency.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Today, more than 80% of employers hire their MDWs with the help of an EA.

sections.label: Post-placement checks by employment agencies
sections.summary: From 1 December, all employment agencies must conduct post-placement checks that MDWs and employers are adjusting well.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: From 1 December onwards, we will also require all employment agencies to conduct post-placement checks to ensure that MDWs and their employers are adjusting well.

sections.label: MDWs investigated for false information
sections.summary: Police investigated and warned 17 MDWs for false information against a household member or employer; 13 were blacklisted and four pending review.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Over the past two years, Police investigated and issued warnings to 17 MDWs for providing false information against a household member or employer.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Of these, 13 were blacklisted and the remaining four are pending a review of case facts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Upon thorough investigation by the Police, the MDW admitted to providing false information against her employer in a bid to end her employment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: She was charged under the Penal Code for providing false information, convicted and sentenced to four weeks’ imprisonment.
